title: canthium oliganthum var. microphyllum
intro: Canthium oliganthum var. microphyllum, commonly known as the "Indian pennywort", is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Canthium oliganthum var. microphyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the pharmacological effects of this plant, but its traditional use suggests potential applications in treating various health conditions.
